data.name: HELLDIVERS™ 2
data.detailed_description:
Edição Deluxe digital

A edição inclui:

  • Conjunto de Armadura ‘Salvador dos Livres DP-53’.

  • Capa ‘Vontade do Povo’.

  • Arma ‘Cavaleiro MP-98’.

  • Estatuto de Super Cidadão.

  • Jogo de Nave Herói de Estratagema.

  • Código de Obrigação de Guerra Premium.


Acerca do jogo


A Última Linha de Ataque da Galáxia.

Alista-te nos Helldivers e junta-te à luta pela liberdade numa galáxia hostil neste jogo de tiros na terceira pessoa rápido, frenético e feroz.

TRANSMISSÃO URGENTE – FORÇAS ARMADAS DA SUPER TERRA

Liberdade. Paz. Democracia.
Os teus direitos como um cidadão da Super Terra. Os pilares principais da nossa civilização.
Da nossa existência.
Mas a guerra continua. E mais uma vez, estamos a ser atacados.
Junta-te à maior força militar que a galáxia alguma vez viu, e transforma-a num local seguro e livre para se viver.

TORNA-TE NUMA LENDA

Tu vais ser colocado em esquadrões de até quatro Helldivers e vão-te ser atribuídas missões estratégicas.
Protejam-se uns aos outros – o fogo amigo é uma certeza infeliz da guerra, mas a vitória sem trabalho de equipa é impossível.*

EQUIPAMENTOS

Bombardeia liberdade do céu, usa ação furtiva para infiltrares território inimigo, ou cerra os dentes e corre em direção à ação.
Como ofereces liberdade é contigo; vais ter acesso a uma grande variedade de poder de fogo explosivo, armadura que te vai salvar a vida e estratagemas que mudam o curso da batalha… a joia do arsenal de todos os Helldivers.

REQUISIÇÃO

A Super Terra reconhece o teu trabalho árduo com Requisições valiosas. Usa-as para acederes a recompensas diferentes que te possam dar uma vantagem a ti, ao teu esquadrão, à tua nave destruidora e ao esforço de guerra global.

AMEAÇAS

Tudo em todos os planetas querem que morras. É isto que temos de enfrentar.
Cada inimigo possui características, táticas e comportamentos diferentes e imprevisíveis – mas todos eles combatem de forma feroz e sem medo ou moralidade.

A GUERRA GALÁCTICA

Capturar planetas inimigos, defender contra invasões e completar missões vai contribuir para o nosso esforço global.
Esta guerra vai ser ganha ou perdida dependendo das ações de todos os envolvidos.
Ou estamos juntos, ou perdemos tudo.

content_descriptors.notes: HELLDIVERS™ 2 é um jogo de tiros por equipas na terceira pessoa que vê as forças elite dos Helldivers a batalharem para vencerem um conflito intergaláctico e se verem livres de ameaças alienígenas crescentes. A partir de uma perspetiva na terceira pessoa, os jogadores usam uma variedade de armas (pistolas, metralhadoras, lança-chamas) e estratagemas (torres, ataques aéreos, etc.) para dispararem e matarem forças inimigas. O combate é acompanhado por sangue e desmembramento das forças alienígenas. O desmembramento e esguicho de sangue também pode ser observado quando os jogadores são atingidos por explosões no ambiente ou fogo amigo. Os acampamentos inimigos e ambientes do campo de batalha mostram manchas de sangue e corpos desmembrados.

reviews.review:
Well, here it is. Ever since it was originally suspected months ago, Easy Anti Cheat has hit Helldivers 2, and it is honestly one of the most embarassing displays I've seen in a while put up by a Game Studio that was already disliked enough as is by many almost exclusively due to the decisions that Arrowhead has made over the course of the year. 

So let me get this straight; You- An entire Company worth ~532 Million USD- cannot address basic game glitches (which you allegedly form ad-hoc development teams for, which makes this even more embarassing) and shortcomings in design. That's not okay, but it's not the end of the world objectively, because thankfully, for those who wish for Helldivers to be better, Modding was an option. Yet, in spite of it's objectively positive effect on the communities that enjoyed them at no expense of those who did not, Arrowhead chose to do everything in it's power to destroy the basis of them.

And for clarification, I'm not here to advocate for cheats, I understand live service games have their right to certain boundaries in modding, I'm here talking about this being detrimental for the countless players who went out of their way to create and use mods specifically catered to either fixing known glitches, or just making the gameplay smoother and more cohesive. Hellpod Steering Fixes, Vaulting/Climbing Fixes, AI Fixes, among others. These did not provide any sort of advantage over the average player and were almost entirely ran locally on the user's computer (unlike what Arrowhead would otherwise claim in their update post), and would only really be seen in a bad light if you interpret shortcomings in design or genuine bugs in development as the intended product (in spite of Arrowhead's own statements addressing them as 'bugs'), which is a painfully narrow perspective once you compare Helldivers' shortcomings in development to many other titles that allow or facilitate such mechanics while following similar principles in the desired gameplay envisioned by Arrowhead.

No one asked for this arbitrary removal of easy access to such fixes and the like, in fact; The majority wished for the opposite (as seen with the sheer popularity and positive endorsement these mods gained), or simply abstained, because in the end, what good could come from this other than potentially bragging rights for those in either side of the toxic ends of the game's community? 

To put into a detached perspective what this is like for someone outside of the usual communities that this concerns:

 Imagine that you have a series of plumbing issues in your house, and your local governing entity is supposed to provide public plumbing services for those in need like yourself. Yet, in spite of filing countless complaints and requests for the plumbing issues to be fixed in your house, the local governing entity fails to do anything about it. When they do finally send someone over, instead of fixing your plumbing, they somehow manage to break your house's heating, and after the fact, the local governing entity proudly post the work they carried out on your home that day- completely out of touch of the fact that they somehow broke a vital part of your house's ecosystem- and acredit themselves as great public service providers. With all of this having upset you, you logically turn to private plumbing providers, the local governing entity technically hasn't outlawed them, not yet, but they're unendorsed and operate outside of the usual scope of the local governing entity. You call them, and the very next day they show up, fix your plumbing and on top of that, they also fix your heating and advice you on some other things that might be wrong. You're happy, not because this private plumbing service is better than the local governing entity's, but because your plumbing is fixed, and a little extra too. So, you start advicing your neighbours having the same problems as you about this private plumbing service, some don't agree and choose to wait for the local governing entity to do their work, which is fine, but some others take you up on your recommendation, and they're equally pleased as you with the private plumbing service's work. However, the local governing entity catches wind of this from your local community, but instead of endorsing the private plumbing service, they place harsher laws in place to run them out of business and strictly enforce that plumbing may only be carried out by their public plumbing services, who to this day have made no positive change in their work ethic, of course. As if this was not bad enough, they send inspectors over to your house, and when they find that your plumbing had been fixed by private plumbing services, they break your plumbing in retaliation. 

That's what is going on right now, and I cannot say for certain where the line in the sand is drawn at anymore. This isn't security against malicious cheats (such as what genuinely happens on games like early black ops titles with people being digitally attacked), this isn't moderation of unfair cheats, this is persecution of community-ran upgrade projects solely on the basis of what I can only asume to be jealousy, envy or blind hatred and prejudice. I have frankly lost all hope in Arrowhead, and I hope this helps make up your mind about who exactly you are trusting your money, time and disk drive space with.
